snippet.title: Newton's Promise - Trailer
snippet.description:
💙 Wishlist Newton's Promise on Steam & Play the Demo during Steam Next Fest!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3852190/Newtons_Promise/

Newton's Promise is a game where you face endless waves of enemies through diverse builds and weapons, while uncovering the mysterious promise that drives Newton to rise through the skies.
The game will feature many upgrades and difficulty options if you're looking for an extra challenge!

The game is inspired by those weird "fake YouTube ads" mobile games ... you definitely know what I
mean!

#indiegame #roguelike #pixelart #games #gametrailers
